result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, brand-led framing built on a promise addressed to 'you' (customers, patients) before the company's own commitments. Uses first-person plural 'we' and 'strive', a hedged commitment. Most of the page is navigation and extensive legal disclaimers about country-specific products and external links. Values are stated briefly, with little elaboration.
